facts.fact: Rest of World reports Galaxy Backbone, a government-established company, runs two data centres in Abuja and Kano and provides core cloud services to government agencies and private companies (dated to the article, 2025-02-25, which gives no opening date).
Rest of World reports that AWS, Microsoft and Google have no data centre in Nigeria apart from a small AWS local zone opened in Lagos in 2023 (a local zone is not a region); as of 2025-02-25.

systems.system: Layer3 cloud (colocated in two Lagos and one Abuja data centres)

note: AWS Lagos local zone is not a region.
